title: No sound from one speaker

items: broken wire in speaker wire harness

content.description: Flowchart for testing speaker connection. Starts with checking if speaker is connected. If No, connect. If Yes, pull out connector and reinsert. If OK, inspect connector. If No after reinserting, proceed to Test 2. Includes a continuity test symbol.

Flowchart for troubleshooting speaker. Starts with temporarily installing another speaker. If Yes (Okay), replace speaker. If No, check for continuity in speaker wire harness. If OK, replace radio and tape player. If No, inspect and repair wire speaker wire harness.
